Input: the routing engine over provider_fixtures.host_capacity_fixture with autospec _execution_profile, _admit_review_execution and _save is a restored activation whose host constraint (the same limits and demands) is approved by a public configure. The configuration caps the AI roles and external_action and leaves the Lean roles uncapped (execution_profiles.UNCAPPED_ROLES), and only AI and Lean roles run as native Jobs (launch.ticket), so the legacy capped formal_check Job cannot occur in the product: host admission is observed on external_action.

Input: the routing engine over provider_fixtures.host_capacity_fixture with autospec _execution_profile, _admit_review_execution and _save is a restored activation whose host constraint (the same limits and demands) is approved by a public configure. The configuration caps the AI roles and external_action and leaves the Lean roles uncapped (execution_profiles.UNCAPPED_ROLES), and only AI and Lean roles run as native Jobs (launch.ticket), so the legacy capped formal_check Job cannot occur in the product: host admission is observed on external_action. The start callback is observed on a formal_check Job admitted in the starting state: the _save side_effect is ObservedCalls capturing the execution's process identity and status at each _save (one, with the identity and running). The unconfirmed local termination (a launched Job of that name that has not ended, on the Jobs fake instead of the named_job_empty patch) is held on the formal_check Job and, for its reservations, on a capped native Job: AI research work under the host constraint, whose host and slot reservations all stay unsettled.
